Jornal da Globo was relaunched for a second time in 1979 and hosted by Sérgio Chapelin, ending again in 1981 before being relaunched for a third time in its current incarnation in 1982.

title: The Killer Among Us
description: Hosted by Alan Cumming, a shocking murder rocks a tight-knit community to its core. But what if the crime wasn't committed by a stranger or outsider? What if this killer is part of the community itself?

title: Leo talks
description: Leo Talks is a parody of what motivational talks are, carried out by humorist Leo Harlem, with an objective totally contrary to the positive and inspiring tone that the originals give off. Undoubtedly, it is a format that proposes a renewed formula of the classic "Stand up Comedy".

title: Emily to Maria
description: Two lifelong friends in their mid-thirties begin questioning their lives and future when an encounter with a younger woman prompts them to reflect on aging, identity, and what truly makes them happy.

title: Anything is possible
description: The show tells the story of Meriç and Deniz, two very different personalities in their late twenties living in Istanbul, and their relationship with each other and with life. We watch them confront themselves in absurd situations. We see how these two women, mostly with completely different, opposing views and stubbornness, come together in shared worries and problems, and support each other.

title: Major League Wrestling: Fusion
description: Fusion is the Premiere show Major League Wrestling

title: The Loyalty Game
description:
The series follows Ben (Jericho), a respected lawyer and senatorial candidate, and Anna (Janine), his devoted wife, who are admired by their community as the picture of a perfect couple. But beneath their seemingly ideal relationship lies a web of secrets that threatens to unravel everything they have built together.

Driven by growing suspicions that her husband may be hiding something, Anna hires a group of loyalty testers to uncover the truth. As her investigation deepens, she finds herself drawn into a dangerous game where trust is tested, loyalties shift, and every discovery brings unexpected consequences.

title: Strange: Junji Ito's Tales for Sleepless Nights
description: Live-action anthology TV drama series adapting stories from Junji Ito's "Masterpiece Collection."

title: Isakapatnam
description: Set in the 1990s, in the ruthless port town of Isakapatnam, three forces collide—a woman driven by justice, a henchman torn by loyalty, and a common man hungry for revenge—each closing in on the empire built by the port’s most powerful man, Naidu.

title: United
description: 'United' tells the story of a group of 13-year-old friends who play for the same local mixed-gender football team. Their biggest dream is to one day become professional footballers. Their friendship is tested when one of them is scouted by the major rival professional club in the same city. The player faces a heartbreaking decision: will he pursue his dream and join the rival club, or will he choose to stay with his friends?

title: Tom Scott: England
description: Tom Scott takes a road trip to every county of England, travelling by car, train, boat, plane, tram, monorail and hovercraft, visiting hidden infrastructure, ancient traditions, and more bells than you might expect.

title: Beneath the moon's shadow
description: One night, a mysterious series of murders occurs, and all victims are connected to "Kantakwee," a famous young actor. Later, "Lieutenant Thara," a tough female police officer, finds the body of "Natcha," a lawyer and her sworn enemy, lying in a pool of blood, murdered by the killer. Thara miraculously saves Natcha's life, but when Natcha recovers, she has lost almost all of her memory. Natcha becomes a key witness that Thara must protect 24/7. However, Natcha's amnesia makes Thara wonder if she is truly a victim or the killer... As they live together to uncover the truth, their closeness gradually transforms into a bond. But danger lurks in their relationship every minute, as the serial killer relentlessly hunts Natcha! As Natcha's memories slowly return, she draws closer to death. Can her former rival become her lover?

title: Tamizha Tamizha
description: Film director and actor Karu Pazhaniappan hosts debates on current affairs and topics which can bring about change in the society.

title: Dating Alys Perez
description: Years after moving to the US, Alys returns home as a successful pastry chef while building a life with Tripp. But seeing Drake again revives old feelings and unresolved heartbreak, pulling the three into an emotional journey of love, sacrifice, and second chances.

title: Revenge Girl
description: Su Wan undergoes plastic surgery to take on the identity of Ji Xiaoxue and joins forces with Xia Wanqing in a quest for revenge against the Gu family. As their carefully orchestrated plan unfolds, the Gu family's two sons find themselves ensnared in a web of emotional manipulation and legal consequences.

title: Leef Jou Reis
description: Gerrie Pretorius explores unique travel destinations that are close to his heart and gives tips to those who want to visit these destinations as well.

title: The Real Housewives van het Zuiden
description: A reality series that follows some of the most upper class women from the south of the Netherlands as they enjoy their lavish and luxury lifestyle.

title: The Harry Hill Show
description:
Hello there! It's me, Harry Hill!

I've got a new show, and this time, it's visualised, A VODSCARF.

Join me, my son Gary and Sarah the A.I Bot as we talk to a motley crew of comedians, celebrities and cultural icons, and if that wasn't enough we all learn together as we speak to an expert on stuff like the big bang, day of the dead, and even FLIES as part of our theme of the week! PLUS introducing the game everyone is talking about, Name The Seed

title: 谜案拼图
description: Deputy captain Li Kaiyang and his apprentice Jiang Han investigate a series of brutal murders, including sexual assault cases and mysterious nude corpse killings. When the supposedly dead “Red Gloves” killer appears to return, the two detectives race to uncover a long-hidden mystery connected to the crimes.

title: MasterChef Serbia
description: The most famous show and TV program that breaks viewership records all over the planet. The best according to the opinion of a three-member expert jury, at the end of the season will take the flattering title of the winner of the first MasterChef Serbia and will be 50 thousand euros richer

title: Daggerheart: Azerim
description: Baradun and the Dickheads return, and this time they have landed in Daggerheart!  What begins as a light-hearted adventure in the Beast Feast campaign frame, filled with bizarre creatures & questionable cooking, soon reveals a much darker mystery.

title: 大吉中介
description: Recently released from prison, Lin You unexpectedly becomes a haunted-house tester for the Daji Agency. Partnering with Xu Liuliu, a girl gifted with extraordinary vision, he investigates a series of supernatural cases that reveal hidden truths. As they uncover the human stories behind each case, they help restless souls find peace while confronting their own inner struggles.

title: Super Heroes
description: Real heroes live among us. Because lies are bad, sometimes you need to be a superhero to get through the week...

title: You're My Favorite Song
description:
You're My Favorite Song is a heartwarming romance drama that follows Angel, a brilliant young girl determined to fulfill her dying grandfather's lifelong dream of building a beach resort.

But when a powerful business empire sets its sights on their prized beachfront property, Angel finds herself in an uphill battle to protect her family's future. With the help of her classmates, she embarks on a journey filled with friendship, first love, and the courage to stand up for what matters most.

Together, these young dreamers must fight to save the resort, honor a cherished legacy, and prove that even the biggest dreams can come true.

title: Dara-san of Reiwa
description: After venturing into a restricted, treacherous mountain forest, siblings Hinata and Kaoru meet a terrifying serpent god and become besties! Despite her initially scary appearance, the self-named "god of misfortune" is awkward, lonely, and surprisingly easy to talk to.

title: Please Hold On to My Character
description: A journey of soul swapping opens up two different lives. From confrontation to camaraderie, from misunderstanding to understanding, what kind of emotional journey did they experience?

title: Flower Angels: On the Fragrance of Magic Flowers
Zombie House Flipping: Family Business
description: In Columbus, Ohio, power flipper Tommy Harr and his family have built a business on seeing opportunity where others see disaster. Their edge comes from within the family — two generations of elite home inspectors, a fearless construction crew led by his middle brother, and a mom who doubles as both designer and real estate agent. Together, they take on the city’s worst “zombie” houses, transforming rundown properties into stunning dream homes.

title: Blazing Summer
description: Cast members of "Never-Ending Summer" reunite for a two-day variety show experience, taking part in games and compatibility tests to determine the best acting duo.

title: Jimmi: Paisa Aur Paap
description: Runa's sudden shift in behaviour shocks everyone. Meanwhile, the real owner of the box frantically searches for it.

title: Race Around the World
description: The ABC's original 90s documentary reality show returns with a new generation of filmmakers. Six storytellers. Ten films. One winner. Hosted by Zan Rowe with original 90s Racer John Safran, it's a ride you don't want to miss.

title: Jaffnadaraya
description: A compelling drama series exploring identity, survival, and the intricate bonds of community in Jaffna. As personal ambitions collide with deeply-rooted traditions, ordinary citizens must navigate complex modern challenges while fighting to protect the people and heritage they hold dear.

title: This Was SportsCenter: Stories from the Set
description: Go behind the scenes of the iconic SportsCenter set and newsroom during the late 1990s and early 2000s with firsthand stories and memories from many of the personalities who helped define the show's cultural impact.

title: The Rhythm of Revenge
description: Singer Puna dreams of stardom and uncovering the truth behind her parents' deaths, forming an alliance with a police officer as the hunt turns personal.

title: Fursan Quraih
description: The Forsan Graih team is struggling, with no championships in sight! Abu Othman must revive the club's former glory and make it the talk of the town once again.

title: Startup Singam
description: Innovation, ambition and investment collide as entrepreneurs from Tamil Nadu pitch for funding and equity to turn their ideas into the next big success.

title: Harry Potter: The Official Film Podcast
description: Hosted by acclaimed film critic and broadcaster Rhianna Dhillon, this podcast offers a thoughtful rewatch experience that balances high‑level film recaps with in-depth discussion of the moments that matter most by revisiting key sequences and themes and diving deeper into standout scenes, performances and creative choices. Each episode explores the whimsy, heart and cinematic craft behind the films, while reflecting on why Harry Potter continues to resonate so powerfully with audiences around the world, and appeals to fans and newcomers alike.

title: The Running of Love and Money
description: A group of friends known as Gen Me navigate lives filled with love, dreams, and the challenges of survival in a fast-paced society. As they enter adulthood, they struggle with relationships, personal aspirations, and growing responsibilities, learning difficult lessons along the way while relying on one another for support.

title: Midnight Mart
description: The series centers around the atmospheric, intimate late-night interactions between two young women inside a 24-hour convenience store.

title: Sith Athara Histhan
description: The story follows a group of interconnected characters who live together but feel deeply isolated from one another. It highlights how a lack of true communication, hidden secrets, and busy everyday routines build invisible walls between loved ones. As these secrets come to light, the characters must choose whether to break down their walls, face their vulnerabilities, and talk to each other, or let the growing silence permanently ruin their relationships.

title: Rookie Truckers
description: It's one of the world's toughest and most dangerous jobs. And as a nationwide driver shortage threatens to stall Australia's economy, a new generation of Rookie Truckers is stepping in to take the wheel. Guiding them through this baptism-by-fire are Yogi, Steve, and Sludge—three long-haul veterans determined to pass on the torch before they hang up their keys.Facing blowouts, breakdowns, and extreme weather on the open road, the Rookie Truckers are pushed to the limit to earn their stripes—and a full-time job. They meet all kinds of colourful characters as they crisscross the continent. And along the way, fine-tune their survival skills, master the art of bush mechanics, and grow into the truckers who will keep Australia moving. Gritty and gripping, it's a high-stakes all-terrain journey packed with rugged landscapes, real drama, and storylines of mentorship and transformation.

title: Beter as Gister
description: Beter as Gister is a South African, Afrikaans-language television drama series which revolves around four families and especially the role of the men in them, inspired by the question: Why are fathers held to a different standard than mothers?

title: Big Stage
description: A total of 10 BBNU stars consisting of five male and five female stars compete in the Big Stage main stage.

title: Dover 24/7: Britain's Busiest Port
description: The series takes viewers inside some of the key port control centres to meet frontline staff and shine a light on the teamwork, expertise, operational challenges, and crucial minute-by-minute decisions that impact millions around the UK to reveal some of the huge 24/7 operation that keeps the nation's most important transport hub open for business. From the terminal and port control teams to the Port of Dover Police and the ferry and cruise companies, viewers will get to know the individuals keeping the port moving around the clock.

title: Your Face Sounds Familiar (Greece)
description: Ten artists of the greek showbiz have to dress up in singers and imitate them in the voice, in the dance and in the movements. The choices are determined by a buzzer. The artists have one week to try the performance.

title: Takkema
description: Takkema follows the journey of brilliant, independent women facing the challenge of finding a partner who can match their ambitions. In a male-dominated society, they search for that rare bird : a husband willing to step aside and let them shine. Confronted with growing loneliness, these women decide to break the mold and take control of their own happiness. This quest for love, full of twists and turns, will shake up both their certainties and societal prejudices.

title: Hastinapur Ke Veer
description: Hastinapur Ke Veer explores how no child is born into war but shaped into it. Told through a child-centric lens, it delves into Duryodhan's need for validation, Yudhishthira's burden of righteousness, Arjun's longing for approval, Bheem's instinctive justice, and Karna's abandonment. With flawed parenting at its core, the show reveals how love, silence, and choices shape destiny, making war a result of emotional wounds rather than fate.

title: Twenty One
description: It's about a mysterious and complicated police case, and the description reads: "I love girls who are made to fight life."

title: Shadow Hunter
description: A documentary series about the paranormal, hosted by Darryll Walsh, a ghost hunter, best-selling author and doctor of parapsychology.

description: Amid pressure and fierce competition, the sounds of the khaen, the phin, and the lively mor lam sing rhythms become the driving force that allows the Singto Kimhan troupe to stand strong once again.

description: Happu lives happily with his family and works day and night as a policeman. However, his life is filled with humorous events and misadventures at home and at work.

description: A Coupang Play documentary that captures the 594-day journey the national football team has undertaken to achieve victory in the CONCACAF World Cup, where the fate of South Korea's golden generation of soccer hangs in the balance. With less than a week remaining until the tournament, the documentary captures, through a sharp lens, the most sincere inner thoughts of the players who have given their all amidst ceaseless controversy.

description: Celebrity contestants compete in singing competitions, all while under complete disguse. The panelists must make their identity guesses with the help of clues and voices. Each night, the least popular Masked Singer is eliminated and must reveal their identity until there is just one winner.

description: The housing market is still a disaster. To do something about it, RTL is now launching *Huizenruilers* (House Swappers). This program follows people who are stuck in their current situation. Think of families outgrowing their homes or people who simply want to downsize. Instead of endlessly searching for a new and, above all, suitable place to live, they decide to swap with another household. But there is a small catch!

description: AEW has been Broadcasting PPV's since 2018

description: From the mud-slicked night tournaments to the World Cup flex-board wars, this is a deep dive into the obsessive and deep-rooted football culture of Kerala

title: Little Steps
description: A family drama inspired by real stories from Kuwaiti society. the series explores love, separation, and unspoken emotional struggles within one family. Through quiet moments and layered relationships, Little Steps reflects the realities of Gulf families with honesty, warmth, and emotional depth.

description: MKR favourites Manu Feildel and Colin Fassnidge are going Off The Grid on a road trip around Aotearoa to discover local places, local faces, and local produce - with a generous dose of banter for good measure!

description: World champion Nico Rosberg and Formula E driver Emelia Hartford reveal F1 track insights.

description: Rap Icon Pakistan follows a new generation of rappers as they compete through explosive performances, rap battles, rivalries and high-stakes challenges.

title: Everything On The Menu with Braun Strowman
description: WWE star Braun Strowman travels America, attempting to eat every item on restaurant menus during his WWE tour stops.

title: From Sunrise to Sunset
description: Set against the historic 1916 miners' strike on the Greek island of Serifos, the series blends fiction with real events from a landmark moment in the labor movement. Perseas, the son of a miner killed in the island's dangerous tunnels, grows up under the guidance of his strong and unconventional mother, Katerineta, who teaches him to face life with courage and dignity. Forced by circumstance to follow his father's path, Perseas begins working in the harsh and perilous mines from dawn until dusk, struggling to survive in the island's unforgiving landscape. Amid exhausting labor and growing tensions between workers and mine owners, Perseas falls in love with Andromeda, the daughter of a man who stands against him and the miners' cause. Their relationship unfolds alongside the rising unrest of the workers, whose fight for fair treatment and humane working conditions becomes a defining moment in their lives and in the broader history of social struggle.

title: Renovation Island: The Adventure Continues
description: Bryan and Sarah Baeumler take us inside their world of all things renovation, design, and entrepreneurship as they work on an extensive hotel renovation in the Florida Keys while continuing the expansion of projects at their resort in the Bahamas.

title: Silent Mentor
description: At a university medical simulation center, the lives of anatomy professors, body preparation technicians, and body donors intersect, shaping medical students’ understanding of life, death, and compassion while challenging social taboos and revealing the human heart of medical education.

title: 我把末日上交给了国家
Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
description: Inspired by the famous Gujarati column Duniya Ne Undha Chasma by Taarak Mehta, this show captures the everyday life in Gokuldham Co-operative Society, addressing socially relevant issues with humor. At its heart is Jethalal, an uneducated Gujarati businessman, who often seeks guidance from his wise neighbor and friend, Taarak Mehta. Jethalal lives with his naive yet lovable wife Daya Ben and their mischievous son Tapu, whose antics frequently disrupt the peace of the society. The members often warn Jethalal to control Tapu or face eviction. In desperation, he calls his father, Champaklal, from the village, hoping he’ll instill discipline in Tapu. Instead, the grandfather-grandson duo teams up, creating even more chaos and turning Jethalal’s life into a comedic roller coaster. The show blends family dynamics, friendship, and neighborhood bonds with a dose of satire and laughter.

title: Ready Gamer Mum
description: 10 of the best young Kiwi gamers go head-to-head in a variety of video games, in the hopes of winning a $50k prize. The catch? The only person who can touch the controller is... their mum. Hosted by Tegan Yorwarth.

description: Kim Milyoner Olmak İster? (English: Who Wants to Be a Millionaire?), is the fourth Turkish version based off the British game show Who Wants to Be a Millionaire?. The show aired from August 2, 2011 on aTV. Previously hosted by Kenan Işık, Selçuk Yöntem, Murat Yıldırım, and Kenan İmirzalıoğlu, it is currently presented by Oktay Kaynarca. The top prize is 5.000.000 new Turkish liras.

title: Gekkan! Nanmono Anime
description: A new short anime series based on the characters "Nandemo Ikimono" created by illustrator and character designer Yuri Yokomizo. The stories follow the lives of any and all things, from animals and plants to food and objects.

title: IC- Investigação Criminal
description: In this series, you'll delve into the behind-the-scenes stories of cases that shocked and divided the country, following the reconstruction of the truth from the perspective of those who lived through the events firsthand. Prepare to revisit emblematic crimes and understand how every detail, every piece of evidence, and every contradiction helps transform suspicions into answers.

title: Wales' Home of the Year
description: Three experts scour the nation to find the country’s most amazing home. Interior designer Mandy Watkins and architect Glen Thomas will be judging on functionality, distinctiveness and clever design. Joining them is Owain Wyn Evans who has a passion for property and will be looking for a home which reveals the owner’s personality and individual style.

title: Outback Wreckers
description: Professional car salvagers Mike Elliot and his crew venture into the harsh Australian Outback to hunt down abandoned vehicles and hidden automotive treasures. Facing treacherous desert terrains and unpredictable elements, the team strips down wrecked cars to export valuable components and turn a profit.

title: 七十二家房客-第18季（拆放）
Innovation Effect
description: An educational series that explains everyday objects and makes complex science accessible through experiments and playful explanations. It shows how discoveries like waves enabled the smartphone, and explores radioactivity, dark energy, and blood circulation, featuring Curie, Röntgen, Newton, and Einstein, showing science is understandable and engaging.

title: KAMUI: He's Behind You
description: Shizuka is a normal high school girl with the ability to see ghosts. Due to her peculiar tendency to attract ghosts, she works as an assistant to Kamui, a famous psychic. Kamui takes pride in his top-notch psychic abilities, but the way he exorcises ghosts is rather unusual!

title: On Patrol: Live Special
description: The most intense, jaw-dropping and unforgettable moments from REELZ’s hit documentary series On Patrol: Live. These specials show highlights from the more than 50 cameras rolling live on Friday and Saturday nights, following law enforcement officers from across the country. It’s an unflinching look at everything from high-speed pursuits and unpredictable pit maneuvers, to the takedown of felons on the run, surprising hiding spots, and officer interactions with their communities.

From the historic streets of Pennsylvania and the rugged hills of West Virginia to Florida’s sun-soaked coastlines, the neon spectacle of Las Vegas and the vast landscapes of Utah, the series crosses thousands of miles to meet the people and places that reveal a nation shaped by its past, constantly reinventing itself, and defined by bold ambition and striking contrasts.
